Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of V.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.05 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 24% to 18% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2023.
Operating income reached $3.3 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $3.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.05 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 159 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
